answer: Hardware remote attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to authenticate through cryptographic quotes signed by secure processor enclaves. When forged bots proliferate like wild yarrow, an attacker confronts a steep capital ledge, incurring the verifiable cost of dedicated silicon dies for every active identity. Because trust revocation crawls like a glacier through vendor certificate lists, zero-day enclave exploits can remain undetected across the agent fleet.
